tests.description: RM RESULTS TABLE: Accessible parts including applied parts
ME EQUIPMENT for connection to a power source by a plug - measurement of voltage or calculation of stored charge 1s after disconnection of plug from mains supply
Internal capacitive circuits – measurement of residual voltage or calculation of the stored charge in capacitive circuits after de-energizing ME EQUIPMENT
RM RESULTS TABLE: Type B applied parts
Defibrillation-proof applied parts – measurement of hazardous electrical energies

semantic_fragments.content: Maximum allowable stored charge when measured voltage exceeded 60V: 45 μC. This applies to ME equipment connected to power source by plug, measured 1 second after disconnection from mains supply (clause 8.4.3).

Internal capacitive circuits: Maximum allowable residual voltage = 60V; Maximum allowable stored charge when residual voltage exceeded 60V = 45C. Applies to accessible capacitors or circuit parts after de-energizing ME equipment (clause 8.4.4).

Working voltage measurement for batteries: Between opposite polarity of batteries, measured Vdc = 3 Vdc. No AC component detected. Test supply voltage/frequency not applicable (battery-powered device).
